name: White bread
ingredients_raw: REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA) (64%), WATER, SUGAR, YEAST, IODISED SALT, VITAL WHEAT GLUTEN, REFINED PALMOLEIN OIL, SOYA FLOUR, PRESERVATIVES [282 & 200], DOUGH CONDITIONERS [516 & 170 (i)], EMULSIFIERS [472e, 471 & 481 (i)], REGULATOR [260], FLOUR TREATMENT AGENT [510] AND ANTIOXIDANT [300]. (Numbers in brackets are as per International Numbering System) CONTAINS WHEAT AND SOY.
